title: stabilize-slo-enforcer-regional-failover-hotfix
author: Priya Kapoor
commits: fix(slo-enforcer): add region-aware quorum and backoff jitter
fix(slo-enforcer): tighten load-shedding thresholds for short bursts
fix(config): add regional failover routing table and retry policy
test(slo-enforcer): add unit + integration tests for failover ordering
description: Context: After last week's regional incident we saw the SLO enforcer trigger regional failovers that sometimes caused request reordering and aggressive cascading backoffs. This PR stabilizes the enforcer hot path by making failover decisions region-aware (quorum checks + soft-handoff), smoothing backoff hysteresis, and tightening short-burst load-shedding thresholds. Summary of changes: 1) quorum.go: added region-aware quorum calculation and election tie-break using stable node scoring; 2) enforcer.go: soft-handoff path to avoid duplicate failover in-flight; 3) routing: fallback route table that prefers same-region compatible variants and applies a per-request sticky TTL to avoid reordering; 4) config: adjusted circuit-breaker and load-shedding parameters to reduce oscillation for bursts under 30s; 5) tests: added deterministic integration tests that simulate partial region outage and assert no request reordering and bounded failover time. Testing & CI: unit tests and integration tests were added; CI initially failed on an e2e flake (race in test harness) which was fixed by adding a deterministic test barrier; all checks now pass. Rollout plan: immediate squash-merge to main, canary on 5% of traffic in us-west-2 for 1 hour, monitor SLO enforcer metrics and request ordering traces, then gradual ramp to 50% and region-wide rollout. Risk & mitigation: risk of slightly increased latency for failover decisions due to quorum checks (~2-5ms) — mitigated by optimizing quorum path and adding opt-out flag for very low-latency routes. Follow-ups: ENG-4288 implement metrics for per-region failover counts and ENG-4213 evaluate tuning for larger bursts. Related: SUP-9876 customer incident report.

release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover. Changes: region-aware quorum, soft-handoff to prevent request reordering, tightened short-burst load-shedding thresholds. Deploy as a canary to us-west-2 then ramp.
notes_for_oncall: After deploy monitor slo_enforcer.failover_count_by_region, slo_enforcer.backoff_events, and tracing tag 'failover.sticky_ttl'. If failover_count spikes by >200% or request ordering traces appear, abort rollout and revert to previous config.
